messages:
Lina (Design): quick sketch: a micro 'latency strip' above heatmap showing p95 + rps + err in a single line. goal = conserve vertical space for charts. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mini-strip.png

Omar (Frontend): looks promising. question: collapsed label — show explicit p95 value or generic 'Metrics'? explicit is faster to scan.

Nell (PM): agree explicit p95 value. users triaging incidents want immediate tail latency number. put p95 first and bolder.

Tess (a11y): accessibility: ensure pill is focusable, has visible focus ring, and aria-live updates only for meaningful changes (throttle). also increase contrast on error chip.

Lina (Design): noted — p95 bold, error with icon + higher contrast, default label = "p95 210ms". add small sampling toggle (auto/raw) with tooltip explaining cost.

Omar (Frontend): sampling toggle will be aria-pressed and honor prefers-reduced-motion for the expand animation. also add shortcut 'm' to jump to metrics pill.

Nell (PM): acceptance criteria: 1) p95 prioritized visually; 2) collapsed state shows latest p95; 3) sampling defaults to auto and raw requires confirmation for big ranges; 4) keyboard + screen reader friendly.

ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch/mini-strip-proto  build#4920 queued.

Lina (Design): thanks — i'll push updated mock with larger tap targets and the sampling tooltip shortly.
